<!-- pr-reviewer: a78f977ef58c9ef0e7ad8ea2425031fc5970372a -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Test, golden and docs only: all 23 changed files are under `crates/app/tests/` or `docs/decisions/`. No product code, no build.rs / scripts / `.github` / dependency change, no snapshot PNG, no `CHANGELOG.md` edit.
- Coverage did not ride away. `#[test]` count: `solid_law_goldens` 1 -> 3, `golden_cl` unchanged (25), no test removed or ignored. No golden file added or deleted (a golden `.cl`/`.nc` count of 18 changed, 0 added, 0 removed).
- The refusal is asserted by name. `a_lead_on_the_rings_own_circle_is_refused` rebuilds the old 3 mm programs on the same plate and asserts the exact `Warning::Crossing` pairs (6 arc, 12 tangential). A regression that makes the gate pass an unsafe program, or one that changes the crossing law, fails there.
- The guard `every_posted_golden_is_a_program_the_gate_passes` walks every posted `.nc` with a `.cl` twin: judged goldens must verify clean, unjudged ones must be named in `UNJUDGED` with a reason, refused ones must carry the header. `every_depth_law_golden_verifies_exactly_as_before` now pins all 14 clean.
- Golden changes explained and plausible. Changed: `contour_disc_hole.cl`, `contour_tangential_lead.cl`, and the matching `.nc` in 8 dialects (fanuc top dir, haas, sinumerik, heidenhain, mazak, tormach, doosan-dnm, carvera) = 18 files. The `.cl` diffs touch only lead-in/lead-out moves and their rapids/plunges (lead radius 3 -> 2 mm); the ring and outer contour moves are byte-identical, 69 moves each. Every `.nc` has equal +/- line counts. The haas diff matches the CL (e.g. start 37.711,-6.306 -> 38.589,-5.197; I/J follow).
- Moving the builders to `common/solid_part.rs` brings `solid_law_goldens.rs` to 338 lines (was 405), new file 151. Decision recorded in `docs/decisions/862-refused-program-goldens.md`. Body ends `Fixes #862`, has `Changelog: none`.

**Local results** (trial-merged with `upstream/main`, clean merge, own target dir)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `solid_law_goldens` | 3 passed |
| `golden_cl` | 25 passed |
| `conformance` | 6 passed |
| `posting` | 17 passed |
| `solid_law` | 4 passed |
| `fanuc_post` / `tormach_post` / `heidenhain_block_form` / `program_comments` | 11 / 10 / 5 / 4 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --tests -- -D warnings` | clean |

The full quick plan maps to the whole app suite (shared golden input); I ran the golden-covering binaries above plus the ones the author named, not all ~300 binaries.

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `plasma_plate_with_holes` and the slot/trace/trochoid/`arc_planes` goldens stay unjudged, now named with reasons in `UNJUDGED`. Worth an issue if plasma should get its gate verdict in this guard.
- The `REFUSED_HEADER` escape hatch is unused today; fine as a door, but it means a future refused-program golden passes the guard on a first-line string alone.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: a78f977ef58c9ef0e7ad8ea2425031fc5970372a -->
Independent review. Trial-merged with origin/main (a6bd69d8): clean (auto-merge of `solid_law_goldens.rs`, no conflicts). Ready for the maintainer to merge.

**What looks good**
- Golden accounting: 18 files regenerated, none deleted: `contour_disc_hole` and `contour_tangential_lead` as `.cl` plus `.nc` in 8 dialect directories (Fanuc top, haas, sinumerik, heidenhain, mazak, tormach, doosan-dnm, carvera). Each is the one program the gate refused (3 mm leads on the R6 bore's r = 3 ring, `Warning::Crossing`); the lead became 2 mm (`golden_cl.rs`). No golden of a passing program changed; the diff touches no other golden and no snapshot PNG.
- The refused program is not dropped silently: `a_lead_on_the_rings_own_circle_is_refused` rebuilds the old 3 mm programs and asserts the exact crossing pairs (6 and 12), the refusal pin.
- New guard `every_posted_golden_is_a_program_the_gate_passes` walks every `.nc` under `golden/nc/` whose stem is a `.cl` golden: the depth-law verdict must be clean, or the stem is named in `UNJUDGED` with a reason, or the first line carries the "refused program" header. Counts: `solid_law_goldens` 1 -> 3 tests; other files unchanged.
- Helpers moved verbatim into `common/solid_part.rs` (151 lines; diff shows only the header and a trailing blank). `solid_law_goldens.rs` is 339 lines, under the 400 law.
- Goldens are `eol=lf` and the reader normalises CRLF; no line-end failure on this autocrlf checkout.

**Local results (merged with main)**
- `solid_law_goldens` 3 passed; `golden_cl` 25; `conformance` 6; `posting` 17; `fanuc_post` 11; `carvera_post` 4: all pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --tests -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not run: other app suites, ui.

**Notes (non-blocking)**
- Six stems sit in `UNJUDGED` (slots, trochoid, trace, `arc_planes`, `plasma_plate_with_holes`), so their posted programs are not gate-checked by this guard; the PR says so. A follow-up could run the plasma gate on `plasma_plate_with_holes`.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/862-refused-program-goldens.md` records option (a) over (c); fine.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
